summary.note: routing is by the MISSING FACT. A release note cannot say who a product is for, and a pricing page cannot say when something shipped, however well either has performed.

priorities.subject: Salesforce

priorities.why_it_matters: no counterparty has an orderable action stream, so no two-sided timeline and therefore no sequence can exist

Salesforce publishes no dated commerce stream at all

priorities.subject: Toyota

priorities.subject: Adobe Commerce

priorities.subject: Cloudflare

priorities.why_it_matters: the economic chain's UNKNOWN links are all upstream of the company, and no SUPPLIES edge exists in the graph
